description: Use when: can I sell this Base token, and what is the buy/sell tax? Can you actually sell this Base token? Simulates a small buy and a sell back into its deepest WETH pool (Uniswap V2/V3 and Aerodrome) with an eth_call, so nothing trades. Returns sellable yes/no, buy tax %, sell tax %, the pool used, a verdict (sellable, taxed, high tax, honeypot) and coverage notes. No pool, not a token or an inconclusive simulation is not charged. Costs $0.01.
name: base_honeypot_check
